Game Enhancer

Performance-Focused Tuning for Gaming Stability and Responsiveness

Game Enhancer is a Magisk/KernelSU module that applies performance-focused tuning to improve responsiveness, reduce stutter, and maintain more consistent behavior during gaming.

--- ## Why Use Game Enhancer? Stock configurations are balanced for general use. Game Enhancer shifts priorities toward performance during gameplay. - `Higher Stability` — Helps maintain more consistent frame pacing - `Lower Input Delay` — Improves touch responsiveness - `Process Prioritization` — Reduces background interference during gaming - `Network Optimization` — Helps reduce latency spikes in online sessions - `Thermal Awareness` — Aims to avoid sudden performance drops under load --- ## Installation 1. Download the latest `.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/RAAJK20Pro/GameEnhancer/releases) 2. Open Magisk or KernelSU 3. Go to Modules → Install from Storage 4. Select the zip file and reboot --- ## Supported Games Works with most modern Android games, including: - BGMI / PUBG Mobile - Call of Duty: Mobile - Free Fire / Max - Genshin Impact - Mobile Legends --- ## FAQ **Q: Will it cause overheating?** A: It focuses on performance tuning; thermal behavior depends on your device and kernel. --- **Q: Does it work on low-end devices?** A: It can help improve responsiveness by managing background activity, but results may vary. --- **Q: Can I use it with other performance modules?** A: Not recommended — similar tweaks may conflict.

Game Enhancer

Performance-Focused Tuning for Gaming Stability and Responsiveness

Game Enhancer is a Magisk/KernelSU module that applies performance-focused tuning to improve responsiveness, reduce stutter, and maintain more consistent behavior during gaming.

---

Why Use Game Enhancer?

Stock configurations are balanced for general use. Game Enhancer shifts priorities toward performance during gameplay.

  • `Higher Stability` — Helps maintain more consistent frame pacing
  • `Lower Input Delay` — Improves touch responsiveness
  • `Process Prioritization` — Reduces background interference during gaming
  • `Network Optimization` — Helps reduce latency spikes in online sessions
  • `Thermal Awareness` — Aims to avoid sudden performance drops under load

    • ---

    Installation

  • Download the latest `.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/RAAJK20Pro/GameEnhancer/releases)
  • Open Magisk or KernelSU
  • Go to Modules → Install from Storage
  • Select the zip file and reboot

    • ---

    Supported Games

    Works with most modern Android games, including:

  • BGMI / PUBG Mobile
  • Call of Duty: Mobile
  • Free Fire / Max
  • Genshin Impact
  • Mobile Legends

    • ---

    FAQ

    Q: Will it cause overheating?

    A: It focuses on performance tuning; thermal behavior depends on your device and kernel.

    ---

    Q: Does it work on low-end devices?

    A: It can help improve responsiveness by managing background activity, but results may vary.

    ---

    Q: Can I use it with other performance modules?

    A: Not recommended — similar tweaks may conflict.
